script_text: Aries, a rare fire storm ignites your chart this week, shaking the foundations of love and ambition. Tuesday, Mercury sextiles Jupiter in your 5th House, sparking romantic messages and extra side income. Wednesday, Sun in your 4th House opposes Saturn in your 1st House, forcing home identity clashes. Midweek shifts as Thursday Venus enters Leo in your 5th House, radiant for love creativity. Thursday through Sunday, Jupiter in your 5th House draws new suitors while Saturday’s Sun trine Uranus in your 10th House triggers sudden career bonus. The weekend blends playful fire with real professional reward. Thursday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House. Monday is your worst day because Mars squares Pluto in your 11th House tension. Channel your fire element by launching that bold creative pitch before Saturday. Follow for daily updates.
